title: Mainstem intubation: one lung ventilated
summary: At 20 s the tube advances into a mainstem bronchus: compliance roughly halves and resistance rises. In VC both Ppeak and Pplat climb; in PC the tidal volume would fall at the same pressure.
objectives: Recognize a global compliance drop and think of tube position.
Pull the tube back (remove the injector) and watch compliance recover.
